name: Don't Lose Your Head!
source:
A visual novel about four unlucky souls gathered for a ghoulish game show hosted by a woman covered in flames known as Eileen who offers the winner of the game a mysterious prize - and the losers certain death. Who will win? Who will die? And what does it really mean to survive, to live?

[Edited from [url=https://unloveablehands.itch.io/dont-lose-your-head]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部讲述四个倒霉灵魂被迫参加恐怖游戏秀的视觉小说。节目主持人是一位名叫艾琳、浑身浴火的女子——她向最终获胜者许诺了一份神秘大奖，而等待落败者的唯有必死无疑的结局。谁能夺冠？谁会丧命？而所谓“活下来”、所谓“活着”，究竟又意味着什么？

[摘自[url=https://unloveablehands.itch.io/dont-lose-your-head]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
